go-jsonschema generate --schema schema.json --overrides overrides.json --out ./model --package model --type Doc

exec go vet ./model
exec go test -count=1 ./model

-- schema.json --
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "tags":  {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}},
    "count": {"type": "integer"}
  }
}
-- overrides.json --
{
  "refs": {
    "#": {
      "fields": {
        "tags":  {"goType": "[]Tag", "goImports": []},
        "count": {"goType": "int64"}
      }
    }
  }
}
-- go.mod --
module example.com/perfield

go 1.26
-- model/extras.go --
package model

// Tag is referenced via the per-field goType override.
type Tag string
-- model/model_test.go --
package model

import (
	"reflect"
	"testing"
)

func TestDoc_PerFieldOverrides(t *testing.T) {
	rt := reflect.TypeOf(Doc{})

	tags, ok := rt.FieldByName("Tags")
	if !ok {
		t.Fatalf("Doc has no Tags field")
	}
	if got := tags.Type.String(); got != "[]model.Tag" {
		t.Errorf("Tags type = %s, want []model.Tag", got)
	}

	count, ok := rt.FieldByName("Count")
	if !ok {
		t.Fatalf("Doc has no Count field")
	}
	if got := count.Type.String(); got != "*int64" {
		t.Errorf("Count type = %s, want *int64", got)
	}
}
